items.title: 8.3 Relation between macroscopic and microscopic events (dono ka rishta) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.3, printed page 170, with Quick Check 8.1 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Macroscopic events bohat se microscopic events ka result (nateeja) hain jo ek hi waqt ho rahe hote hain. Microscopic events samajh kar hum equilibrium system mein nazar aane wali macroscopic tabdeeliyon ko samjha bhi sakte hain aur in ka pehle se prediction (pehle se andaza) bhi laga sakte hain.

Jab kisi chemical reaction ka equilibrium badalta hai to is ko samjhane wale microscopic events particles ya molecules ki collisions aur naye bonds ka banna hain. Yeh collisions forward aur reverse reactions ki rates badalti hain, aur yeh rates activation energy aur bahar ke factors (jaise temperature, pressure) se affect hoti hain. Yeh sab microscopic events mil kar macroscopic tabdeeliyon ki shakal mein nazar aate hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Macroscopic aur microscopic events mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein hai. Macroscopic tabdeeli bohat se microscopic events ka total hai.

rows: Nangi aankh se nazar aate hain
Nangi aankh se nazar nahi aate
Bohat se particles ka mila jula asar
Alag alag particles (atoms, molecules, ions) ki satah par hote hain
Misal: rang badalna, heat nikalna, precipitate banna, gas nikalna, pressure badalna
Misal: molecules ki collisions, bonds ka tootna aur banna, electrons ka lena dena

blocks.prompt: b) Equilibrium dynamic hai. Microscopic events ke zariye explain karein.
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium par koi tabdeeli nazar nahi aati, lekin reactant molecules ab bhi takra kar bonds tor rahe aur products bana rahe hain, aur product molecules bhi takra kar wapas reactants bana rahe hain. Dono processes bilkul barabar rate se chalte hain, is liye mixture ki composition constant rehti hai jabke molecules ki harkat kabhi nahi rukti.

blocks.prompt: c) H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g) mein equilibrium par products ki concentration zyada hai. (i) Concentration aur time ka graph, (ii) rate aur time ka graph kaisa hoga?
blocks.explanation: (i) H₂O aur CO ke curves oopar se shuru ho kar girte hain, H₂ aur CO₂ ke curves zero se barhte hain; equilibrium ke baad sab curves seedhe (flat) ho jate hain aur products ke curves reactants se oopar rehte hain. (ii) Forward rate sab se oopar se shuru ho kar girti hai, reverse rate zero se barhti hai; dono mil kar ek seedhi line ban jati hain (topic 8.2 ka hamara rate graph dekhein).

answer_figure.alt: Do graph. (i) Concentration vs time: blue curves [H₂O] ya [CO] oopar se girte hain, red curves [H₂] ya [CO₂] zero se barhte hain; dashed line 'equilibrium' ke baad dono flat ho jate hain, red (products) blue (reactants) se oopar. (ii) Rate vs time: red forward rate oopar se girti, blue reverse rate zero se barhti hai; equilibrium par dono mil kar ek seedhi line (forward = reverse).
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: H₂O + CO ⇌ H₂ + CO₂ ke liye (i) concentration-time aur (ii) rate-time graph, jab equilibrium par products zyada hon
answer_figure.long_description: Oopar wala graph (i): shuru mein sirf H₂O aur CO hain, is liye un ki concentration zyada hai aur products ki zero. Reaction chalne par reactants kam aur products zyada hote hain; equilibrium ke baad concentrations badalna band ho jati hain aur products ki line reactants se oopar rehti hai, kyunke products favoured hain. Neeche wala graph (ii): forward rate reactants kam hone se girti hai aur reverse rate products barhne se barhti hai; equilibrium par dono barabar ho kar seedhi line ban jati hain (dynamic equilibrium).

items: Macroscopic tabdeeliyan bohat se microscopic events ka total hain.
Equilibrium ki tabdeeli collisions aur naye bonds se samjhai jati hai, jo forward aur reverse rates badalti hain.
